This dataset publishes **two** data products. The [Boundaries (GeoJSON)](../boundaries/index.qmd)
section covers the spatial polygons; **this section covers the linked-data change history** — the
output of [Pipeline A](../toolchain/pipeline-rdf.qmd).

## What the RDF is

For every PSGC snapshot, Pipeline A emits a **delta** (`delta.ttl` / `delta.nt` / `delta.jsonld`)
describing how Philippine administrative units changed relative to the previous snapshot: created,
deleted, renamed, merged, split, transferred, reclassified, or re-coded. The deltas are serialized
on the [W3C ORG ontology](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-org/) with PROV provenance and Dublin Core
terms.

## Why it exists

PSGC codes are not stable: barangays are continually created, merged, split, renamed, transferred
between parents, and re-coded. The RDF deltas let a downstream system track an entity's identity
across quarters via the 9-digit **correspondence code** (see [PSGC code structure](../references/psgc.qmd))
and answer questions like "what happened to barangay X between 2023 and 2024?".

## What a delta file contains

A walkthrough of [`2023-10-24/delta.ttl`](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/blob/main/2023-10-24/delta.ttl),
the delta for the 2023-10-24 snapshot. It carries three kinds of resources:

**Change events** (`psgc:event/{date}/{seq}`) — typed `org:ChangeEvent`. Each carries the snapshot
date (`dct:date`), a one-line human description (`dct:description`), the change type
(`org:classification` → `psgc:concept/change-type/{type}`), and the entities involved via
`org:originalOrganization` (entity removed/renamed-from) and/or `org:resultingOrganization` (entity
created/renamed-to). For example, a code change:

```turtle
<https://psgc.gov.ph/event/2023-10-24/0082> a org:ChangeEvent ;
    dct:date "2023-10-24"^^xsd:date ;
    dct:description "PSGC code changed from 1380300033 to 1381500036"@en ;
    org:classification <https://psgc.gov.ph/concept/change-type/code_change> ;
    org:originalOrganization <https://psgc.gov.ph/entity/1380300033> ;
    org:resultingOrganization <https://psgc.gov.ph/entity/1381500036> .
```

A creation carries only `org:resultingOrganization`; a deletion carries only
`org:originalOrganization`.

**Entities** (`psgc:entity/{code}`) — the units touched by the delta. The 10-digit PSGC code and the
9-digit **correspondence code** (identity that survives re-codings) are both recorded on
`org:identifier`, the name on `skos:prefLabel`, and population on `schema:population`:

```turtle
<https://psgc.gov.ph/entity/1381500036> a org:OrganizationalUnit ;
    dct:date "2023-10-24"^^xsd:date ;
    schema1:population 15103 ;
    skos:prefLabel "Rizal"@en ;
    org:classification <https://psgc.gov.ph/concept/geographic-level/Bgy>,
        <https://psgc.gov.ph/concept/urban-rural/U> ;
    org:identifier "137602033"^^xsd:string,
        "1381500036"^^xsd:string,
        "137602033"^^psgc:correspondence-code .
```

**Concepts** (`psgc:concept/{scheme}/{value}`) — `skos:Concept` nodes for the controlled vocabularies
used in the delta: `change-type/` (creation, deletion, code_change, …), `geographic-level/` (Bgy,
Mun, …) and `urban-rural/` (Urban/Rural), some with `skos:prefLabel` labels.

This snapshot's 92 events break down as 29 creations, 55 deletions, and 11 code changes — a single
quarter's worth of barangay creation/deletion/re-coding events.
